visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long, slightly wavy brown hair, wearing a white t-shirt, a black backpack, and a black face mask, stands inside a brightly lit convenience store environment. She holds a white and pink prize box with a Stitch character illustration. She looks at the camera while speaking. (2) She reaches her right hand into the open top of the prize box to shuffle the tickets inside. The background shows shelves stocked with various convenience store products like snacks and drinks. The lighting is bright and even, typical of a retail setting. (3) A young girl with long dark hair, wearing a white Mickey Mouse t-shirt and pink shorts, is seen from a high angle. She reaches into the prize box held by the woman to select a lottery ticket for herself. (4) The woman peels open her ticket with both hands, revealing a purple "D" symbol. She displays it clearly to the camera. Her eyes show an expression of surprise and delight. She is standing in front of a refrigerator case. (5) The woman points her finger at a detailed prize list poster taped to a wall. The poster shows various Stitch-themed prizes labeled with letters. She explains which prize her "D" ticket corresponds to while looking closely at the chart. (6) The little girl holds her open ticket, showing an "F" symbol. The woman crouches down next to her, wearing white sneakers and denim shorts. They are both looking at the ticket together in the middle of the store aisle. (7) The woman holds up a small plush Stitch keychain wrapped in clear plastic, which she identified as the D-prize. She points at it with her other hand, highlighting its features for the viewer against the store background. (8) The young girl stands in front of a freezer unit, holding a large horizontal Stitch poster. She looks at the poster with a small smile. The poster features Stitch with a towel on his head, titled "Stitch time to chill." (9) The woman stands holding both the large poster and the small plushie. She waves the plushie towards the camera while smiling broadly behind her mask. The background includes a checkout area and various retail displays.
